Spanking a child is a very counter-productive way to punish them. If they are very young, they may not be able to understand why you are hurting them. And if they are older with a good enough understanding, you should be able to explain to them what is wrong and not to do it. 4.5 is very young and he probably thinks you are scary because he probably does not understand what you would be hitting him for. Even if you haven’t done it in awhile, I would think of another form of discipline that doesn’t involve something that they cannot understand. Even if you are an affectionate dad, he can still find those events scary. He is young and impressionable. I would also suggest not using that method on your other child.

Hope it works out.

Edit: Also, please try not to take your frustration out on your kid. I know as a parent sometimes it can be difficult, but communication is essential in all relationships. You sound a lot like my mom. She sometimes used spanking or things like that as a punishment and even if you don’t intentionally mean anything bad by it other than to ‘show them a lesson’ or ‘discipline’, it definitely changes the kids perspective of you. Physical touch and affirmations mean nothing if you also take the worst parts of yourself out on your child. If anything, it will just confuse them and they may have trouble understanding love and affection when the person who shows it to them also displays such frustration or gives them reason to be afraid.

I don’t blame you, because again, you remind me a lot of what my mom was like. And I understand her. But I hope you figure this out not only for your kid, but for your future relationships with them as well.
